subject: Surge stipend fallback policy for ClearView bake-off
messages:
From: Asha Menon <asha@clearview.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: ClearView bake-off — surge contingency / top-up ask

Hey Marcus,

Quick note from our side as we ramp the integration tests for the competitive bake-off next week (May 25-28). Our infra team just flagged a likely spike in request volume once we flip on a full dataset — we could consume the pilot credits much faster than anticipated.

Two asks:
- Do you have a contingency top-up (one-off) or a short-term stipend we can call on if we hit a surge?
- If credits run out mid-bake-off, would Redwood provide a rollforward window or escrow so we don't lose our progress while procurement negotiates?

This is a time-sensitive decision for our evaluation committee — they want to avoid false negatives due to throttle/credit exhaustion. If you can send a short proposal we can take to procurement (cc'd), that'd be great.

Attached: ClearView_MVP_test_plan.pdf (shows expected peak QPS and token burn).

Thanks,
Asha
Product Lead, Integrations
ClearView Labs
asha@clearview.ai

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Asha Menon <asha@clearview.ai>
Cc: ClearView Labs Procurement <procurement@clearview.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 10:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ClearView bake-off — surge contingency / top-up ask

Hi Asha — thanks for the heads up and the test plan. Appreciate the concrete numbers, that helps.

Short answer: yes — we can offer a time-limited surge stipend with a clear rollback/rollforward guardrail so the bake-off isn't unfairly impacted by a one-time spike. High-level proposal (pdf/xlsx attached):
- Surge stipend: up to 50k tokens (~$2,500 equivalent) credit applied instantly if you hit the threshold.
- Rollforward option: any unused portion of the stipend can be rolled forward to a 14-day extension of the trial window (one-time) upon signed request from procurement.
- Escrow/fallback: we can place the stipend in a short-lived escrow account; credits are reserved for the bake-off dates and released on completion once procurement signs the acceptance form.
- Eligibility: limited to this RFP/bake-off (ClearView) and subject to procurement signature within 10 business days.

I've attached a short term sheet (proposed-stipend-term-sheet.xlsx) with exact trigger thresholds and acceptance language. If that looks OK I can kick the approval loop with Sales Ops (cc'ing Neha & Olga).

Would you prefer a flat token pool or a dollar stipend with token conversion? I can make either work.

Thanks — I'll await procurement's preferred route and will start the ops thread once you confirm.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.com
(415) 555-0198

Attachments: proposed-stipend-term-sheet.xlsx (attachment stub)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: ClearView bake-off — surge contingency / top-up ask

Forwarding ClearView's ask + my proposed term sheet. TL;DR: they want a contingency top-up for an expected spike during the May 25-28 bake-off. I proposed up to 50k tokens and a 14-day rollforward of unused credits once procurement signs.

Key risk/asks for Ops/Legal review:
- Precedent: do we allow rollforward for pilot stipends in the wild?
- Escrow mechanics: Ops will need to reserve credits for the bake-off window and ensure they don't get consumed by other customers.
- Financial exposure: 50k tokens ~ $2.5k — ok to approve in Sales Ops without AM Director sign-off?

Attached: proposed-stipend-term-sheet.xlsx (proposed language)

Can you review quickly and advise if we should: (A) approve as-is, (B) approve with reduced stipend, or (C) ask procurement for a PO/commitment before enabling?

From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>

Cc: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: ClearView bake-off — surge contingency / top-up ask

Marcus — quick read and ok to proceed with controls. My notes:

- Approve a conditional stipend, but reduce exposure: 40k tokens (instead of 50k).
- Rollforward window: 10 days post-bake-off (instead of 14) to limit open-ended extensions.
- Require procurement sign-off + PO or signed acceptance form before credits are released from escrow.
- Flag to Legal: add one sentence preventing creation of broad precedent: "This stipend is a one-off concession for the ClearView Labs bake-off and does not imply future commitments."

If ClearView accepts the reduced numbers I'll route the term sheet through Olga for escrow mechanics and then send a HubSpot note (see link) and a DocuSign envelope.

Neha
Sales Ops Manager
neha@redwood.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Asha Menon <asha@clearview.ai>, ClearView Labs Procurement <procurement@clearview.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Final: ClearView surge stipend — approved terms and next steps

Hi Asha / procurement team — quick update and next steps from my side.

Thanks for the patience while we routed internally. Sales Ops approved a conditional stipend with the following agreed terms:
- Stipend amount: 40,000 tokens (surge pool).
- Trigger: Auto-apply when ClearView's usage exceeds 120% of the planned daily burn documented in the attached test plan during the bake-off window (May 25-28).
- Rollforward: Up to 10 calendar days extension of the trial to use any unused portion of the stipend.
- Escrow & release: Redwood will reserve the stipend in a short-term escrow; credits released to ClearView upon receipt of a signed acceptance form or PO from procurement.
- One-off clause: "This stipend is a one-time concession for the ClearView Labs bake-off and does not set precedent for future stipends."

Attached: proposed-stipend-term-sheet.xlsx (updated per Neha), ClearView_MVP_test_plan.pdf (for reference).

Next steps for procurement:
1) Confirm whether you want tokens or a dollar-denominated stipend (we can convert at current rate).
2) Sign the attached acceptance form and return it to procurement@redwood.com (or I can send DocuSign).
3) Once received, Olga will confirm escrow reservation and I will enable the stipend for the bake-off window.

If you want the DocuSign link I can send it now — otherwise please reply with a signed PDF.

Thanks — excited to see ClearView in the bake-off. Let me know if you want different trigger thresholds.

Best,
Marcus
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.com

Attachments: proposed-stipend-term-sheet.xlsx (attachment stub), ClearView_MVP_test_plan.pdf (attachment stub)
